titulo: Art and Advertising Techniques I & II (visual advertising)
resumen:
Classic advertising techniques: testimonial, endorsement, problem solving, scientific, demonstration, life-style and bandwagon (Unit 4, 1).
Visual advertising sells products, ideas or fantasies and relies on psychology (Unit 4, 2).
Techniques: color psychology, composition (Gestalt), rule of thirds and golden mean (Unit 4).
Continued: focal point, visual path (Z and F), typography, repetition (Unit 5).
Character techniques: body language, direct gaze and three-quarter gaze (Unit 5).
